consequence.statement: A parsing limit was increased so larger trust bundles can be read; no operational failure is described.

original.statement: pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes can now parse a larger amount of PEM data, allowing larger TLS trust bundles to be read.

decision.reason: [ev-db955cc00d69] is a Feature entry saying only that the amount of PEM data `pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes` can parse was increased so that larger TLS trust bundles can be read. Nothing fails, gets rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, and existing inputs that were within the old limit are not described as behaving differently. The only effect is that a capacity limit was relaxed. So "none" (informational) is supportable, and nothing in the evidence justifies a review-class or mandatory-work kind.
